Guidance & outlook: So keeping in view that we want to do at least INR600 crores per quarter going forward for the next 3 to 4 quarters on average, they could be up and down.
Coming to the financial highlights for Q1FY27, revenue for the quarter stood at INR460 crores, registering a year-on-year growth of 20.7% compared to INR381 crores in the same quarter last year.
EBITDA margin for Q1 FY27 remained stable at 8.6%.
Growth & demand: We have increased our order book in the last 3 months to about INR1,860 crores now.
And as of 31st July '26, our order book stood at INR1,864 crores, significantly better than where it was 3 months ago when we addressed the last investor meet.
EBITDA for the quarter stood at INR39 crores as against INR32 crores in the last year same quarter, reflecting a growth of 24.6%, which is more than the revenue growth, so the pricing is better.
Margins & costs: So the basic fund Interarch Building Solutions Limited August 07, 2026 utilization is that the Phase 2 and Phase 3 of heavy structure, which I mentioned earlier, in Andhra itself will be about INR150 crores.
And so about, say, INR70-75 crores, with a good -- I would say maybe with a 20% EBITDA margin on that.
Because this time, we've done around close to 8.5%, 8.6% kind of a margin.
Capex & expansion: So that will be a full - fledged plant during the year, adding to our capacity and making it our fifth fully integrated plant.

So that is overall sort of broad figures, about INR140 crores, INR150 crores in heavy structure, INR50 crores to INR60 crores in the Gujarat Plant 2; Plant 2, not Phase 2 of this but Plant 2 and the open web joist system, 100% export unit.

Some orders, which we did take was a part of the pre -engineered building, there was some heavy structure like in the Tata Electronics plant and a semiconductor plant and a lithium battery plant , which we then got manufactured from outside but 80% to 85% was our standard PEB and 15% was that.
Balance sheet & cash: But as we go forward, and I think our operational leverage and our internal control of expenses ticking in, we should increase our EBITDA.
We had INR26.83 crores positive cash flow in Q1 from operating activities.
The INR26.83 crores is the positive cash flow from operations during the quarter.
Risks & challenges: But I'm very proud to say that today, we are perceived as one of the top players and most of the challenging jobs, challenging clients, very complex clients do come to us for even their newer and newer requirements, knowing that Interarch will be able to o r can.
And if they do and they say yes, then they will be able to execute the challenge, whatever the new kind of buildings may be.
So in the commentary, you have written about our revenue has grown by 20%, EBITDA has increased despite of near -term challenges arising from external market conditions.

guidance.t: Are we confident of recouping that, and I mean, shifting away to 9%, 9.5%, to 10% kind of a margin that we've done in the previous years.
And in terms of the volumes, Interarch Building Solutions Limited August 07, 2026 we will grow around 18% in the volumes.
